annotations.title: Generate citations from DOI or ISBN

description: Use this when the user wants to cite this for me, build a works cited list or a reference generator: give a DOI, an ISBN or a list of them and get APA 7, MLA 9 or Chicago citations plus BibTeX and RIS files. Use it for a doi to citation or isbn to citation, an mla citation generator or a chicago citation generator, or to make bibtex from doi. The metadata is looked up live on Crossref and Open Library. A record those services do not have returns status not_found for that item and the other items still work. Do not use for a source that has no DOI or ISBN, or to cite legal cases, patents or datasets; use format_manual_citation for a manual source.

identifiers.description: 1 to 25 DOIs or ISBNs, e.g. ["10.1038/nphys1170"] or ["9780140328721"]; a https://doi.org/ link and hyphens are accepted.

keep_capitals.description: Words to keep as written, matched case-insensitively, e.g. ["Studies", "London"].

items.description: A word to preserve as supplied, e.g. Studies.

style.description: Citation style: apa7 (default), mla9, chicago_ad or chicago_nb.

name: generate_citations
title: Generate citations from DOI or ISBN
